members.bio: Dr. Minhhuy Le, Head of ICSLab , received a BSc degree in Mechatronics at Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Vietnam in 2009. He got a Ph.D. degree in Control and Instrumentation, Chosun University, Korea, in 2014. From 2019, he is working for the Faculty of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Phenikaa University, Vietnam. His interests are non-destructive testing, UWB radar, signal processing, artificial intelligence, and big data.

Dr. Van Su Luong, a K ey member, received his Bachelor in Electronic and Electrical Engineering from Hung Yen University of Technology and Education, Vietnam, in 2008. He received his Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Department of Mechanical Engineering, National Kaohsiung University of Applied Sciences, Kaohsiung, Taiwan in 2016. Since 2018, he is an employee of Faculty of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Phenikaa University. His research interests include Fluxgate, Spin valve-GMR and TMR magnetometers, Current sensors, E-compass, Eddy-current detectors (EC-NDE), Magnetic Adaptive Testing (MAT-NDE), CMOS-MEMS sensors, and the other Spintronic devices. Dr. Luong was a member of the IEEE Magnetics Society.

Dr. Tran Huy Hung, a Key member, is a dedicated researcher and educator in the field of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. He earned his Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Telecommunications from Hanoi University of Science and Technology in 2013, followed by a Master's degree in Electronics – Computer Engineering from Ajou University, South Korea, in 2015. In 2020, he successfully defended his Ph.D. dissertation in Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Dongguk University, South Korea. Since July 2020, Dr. Hung has been a faculty member in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Phenikaa University. His research areas include Reconfigurable antennas; Wideband antennas ; Antennas for mobile devices ; MIMO antennas .

Dang-Khanh Le, e Key member, received his B.S from the Department of Marine Engineering, Vietnam Maritime University, Haiphong, Vietnam in 2006. He received M.S and PhD degrees in the Department of Marine Engineering, Mokpo National Maritime University, South Korea in 2016, 2012 respectively. He was in position of Postdoc at iSL of Mokpo National University in 2016. He is currently a lecturer at Vietnam Maritime University. His research interests include Instrumentation & Automation Control, Modeling and Simulation: UAV (hexacopter, quadcopter), Ultrasonic Technologies and Applications, Wireless Communications and Signal Processing, Iterative Learning Control (ILC), and Intelligent Transportation Systems .

Quang Vuong Pham is a PhD student in Control and Automation Engineering. He received a Master's degree in Control and Automation Engineering from Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Vietnam in 2013. He has worked as an engineer in several manufacturing plants. Then, from 2022 has been a lecturer at the Faculty of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Phenikaa University, Vietnam. He has research interests in signal processing, sensors and non-destructive testing

XuanQue Nguyen received a BSc degree in Mechatronics at Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Vietnam in 2009. He got an MSc degree in Satellite Technologies at the University of Science and Technology of Hanoi, Vietnam in 2018. He has worked as a Software Engineer and Project Manager in several companies and institutes. Then, from 2024 he has became a lecturer at the Faculty of Computer Science, Phenikaa University, Vietnam. He has research interests in TinyML and embeded system.

The Tuan Trinh graduated from Phenikaa University in 2025, majoring in Control and Automation Engineering, and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in the same field at Phenikaa. His research focuses on artificial intelligence (AI), big data, radar systems, and signal processing , with applications in intelligent sensing and automation .

Phuong Huy Pham graduated from Phenikaa University in 2025, majoring in Control and Automation Engineering, and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in the same field at Phenikaa . His research focuses on Smart Sensors and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) , with an emphasis on evaluating material defects in industrial applications . In addition, he contributes to the development of specialized probes, automated measurement systems, and signal processing workflows , enhancing the reliability of NDT systems in the laboratory.

Tien Dat Le graduated from Phenikaa University in 2025, majoring in Control and Automation Engineering, and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in the same field at Phenikaa. He focuses on research and development of Large Language Model (LLM) systems, with applications in artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and intelligent platforms.

Phuong Thuy Vu is a Research Assistant at ICSLab – Phenikaa University and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence at Brunel University London, UK. She graduated as the valedictorian of the Artificial Intelligence and Robotics program at Phenikaa University in 2025. Thuy focuses on image processing and applications of artificial intelligence, and is also interested in natural language processing and applying AI in graphic design.
